allow: Bash(curl -s http://localhost:8080/static/styles.css | grep -E "^  font: |topbar h1" -A1 | head -6)
Bash(grep -n -E "def rows|def one|def control|\\\\?|replace" app/db.py | head -30)
Bash(python3 -m py_compile app/web.py && docker compose up -d --build web 2>&1 | tail -2)

Bash(TOKEN=$\(grep '^API_TOKEN' .env | cut -d= -f2 | tr -d '"'\); sleep 2; curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://localhost:8080/api/events?limit=2" | head -c 600; echo; curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://localhost:8080/api/events?level=error&limit=1&q=post" | head -c 400)

Bash(TOKEN=$\(grep '^API_TOKEN' .env | cut -d= -f2 | tr -d '"'\); curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://localhost:8080/api/events?limit=2&offset=2" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load\(sys.stdin\); print\([r['id'] for r in d['rows']], d['total']\)"; curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://localhost:8080/api/events?q=started&limit=500" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load\(sys.stdin\); print\(d['total'], len\(d['rows']\)\)"; curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://localhost:8080/api/events?agent=panel" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load\(sys.stdin\); print\(d['total']\)")

Bash(sed -n '/<script>/,/<\\/script>/p' app/static/logs.html | sed '1d;$d' > /tmp/logs_check.js && node --check /tmp/logs_check.js && echo JS_OK && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\\n" http://localhost:8080/logs)
